{{Top|NJO}}
An '''environmental bubble''' was a structure that could be used to allow someone to survive in space. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] shot down [[Leth Liav]]'s fighter and sent her in one such bubble to the surface of [[Borealis]]. She was rescued along with others by [[Twin Suns Squadron]].<ref name="Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>
